subject: Quick check on pilot timing and approvals for FintechX
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:15:10 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: Redwood pilot for FintechX

Thanks again for your time on the call this morning, Liam — quick recap and where we land next.

Scope recap:
- 2-week evaluation (staging) of the payment-friction model using a 5M-token sample.
- Endpoint integration via our hosted API + optional private VPC for sandboxing.
- Success criteria: 10% reduction in false declines, <150ms p95 latency for peak paths.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short SOW and a capacity estimate for your review (Redwood_Pilot_SOW.docx, capacity_estimate.xlsx).
2) If that looks good, we can schedule a 30-minute tech onboarding with our solutions engineer (Rishi).
3) Procurement -> finalize PO/terms. We can provide a temporary trial credit if that helps speed approval.

Timing question: I know quarter-end is coming up — is approval/budget review happening before 6/30, or should we plan for an early-July start? Knowing that will help us prioritize resources.

If easier, happy to hop on a quick 10-minute call with you + procurement to walk the SOW.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_SOW.docx (docx), capacity_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 11:02:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: Redwood pilot for FintechX

Sounds good — thanks for the notes. A couple of tactical thoughts:
- If we don't hear back by 6/20, I recommend a short bump offering a modest pilot credit or an extended trial window (helps procurement justify spend).
- I'll prep a one-page security snapshot (SOC2 highlights + data handling) to include with the SOW.
- Happy to join any procurement call and speak to SLA/retention details.

I'll draft the bump email and the security one-pager; want me to send both or have you keep it from your mailbox?

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Quick bump: SOW attached + question on timing

Hi Liam — following up on the SOW I sent last week (attached again).

Short ask: are budget and legal approvals still on track to clear before your quarter close, or has priority shifted into July? If approvals are slipping, we can:
- Hold the SOW open and schedule kickoff the week of July 7, or
- Offer a one-week staging credit to let you validate technical fit while procurement completes paperwork.

Also tagging Rishi in case procurement wants a quick technical walkthrough.

Thanks for any update — even a one-line status helps us plan capacity.

Best,
Monica

Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_SOW.docx (resend)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechx.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fintechx.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 15:32:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick bump: SOW attached + question on timing

Hi Monica — apologies for the delay and thanks for the follow-ups. Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed the budget approval timeline into early July due to an internal reforecast. That means we can't finalize spend before 6/30, but we'd still like to proceed.

A couple of asks from procurement/tech:
- Can you provide a short SOC2 summary and clarify data retention for staging (how long logs and KV cache are retained)?
- Estimated monthly run-rate for the pilot if we scale to the 5M-token sample (so we can include in the cost model).

If possible, can we schedule a 20-minute sync next Tue (7/1) to align on approvals and the staging plan? Procurement are copied here.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Product — FintechX
liam.oconnor@fintechx.com | +1 (617) 555-0129
